questions.prompt: When does Mia read a book?
questions.explanation: Mia says In the evening I read a book.

questions.prompt: What does Mia do before dinner?
questions.explanation: Mia says I do my homework before dinner.

image.describe: Smarty and Mia sit at a table. Mia tells Smarty about her day.

mission.setup: Tell Smarty about your day. Say what you do in the morning and in the evening.

turns.smarty: What do you do in the morning?
accept: ^i (?:get up|brush my teeth|take a shower)(?: in the morning)?$
^first i (?:get up|brush my teeth|take a shower)$
^in the morning i (?:get up|brush my teeth|take a shower)$
turns.example: In the morning I get up.
turns.hint: Say something you do in the morning.

turns.smarty: And then?
accept: ^then i (?:brush my teeth|take a shower|go to school|get up|read a book)$
^i (?:brush my teeth|take a shower|go to school)$
turns.hint: Say what you do next. Start with Then.

turns.smarty: What do you do in the evening?
accept: ^i (?:do my homework|read a book|watch tv|eat dinner|go to bed)(?: in the evening)?$
^in the evening i (?:do my homework|read a book|watch tv|eat dinner|go to bed)$
^after dinner i (?:do my homework|read a book|watch tv|go to bed)$
turns.example: In the evening I read a book.
turns.hint: Say something you do in the evening.
